sources.title: Define a User Coordinate System (.NET)
sources.paraphrase: The managed example takes GetPoint.Value as a current-UCS point and explicitly transforms it to WCS.
sources.distinction: The VBA/ActiveX Utility.GetPoint example on the same page uses a different API. Its WCS input contract is not applied to Editor.GetPoint.

sources.title: Editor.GetPoint(PromptPointOptions)
sources.paraphrase: The method reference describes point input but does not specify the coordinate system.

sources.title: PromptPointResult.Value
sources.paraphrase: The property exposes the entered Point3d; its short description does not specify UCS or WCS.

sources.title: Editor.CurrentUserCoordinateSystem
sources.paraphrase: The current user coordinate system is exposed as Matrix3d.

sources.title: Table Class
sources.paraphrase: The documented class hierarchy makes Table a subclass of BlockReference.

sources.title: BlockReference.Position
sources.paraphrase: The inherited insertion-position property is explicitly expressed in WCS.

scope.new_dwg_table: Capture UCS before GetPoint; reject changes after the pick and before the first write; transform exactly once.
scope.existing_table_update: Existing Position is already WCS; never transform it again.
scope.xlsx_only: No insertion point or new UCS dependency.
scope.unchanged_ucs_policy: Project defensive policy, not a claimed Autodesk-mandated rejection algorithm.

runtime_reproduction: Separate evidence required; this file is API analysis only
